# Sensory Observation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SensoryObservation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

An observation produced by a sensor or sensory apparatus reading a physical property of the environment. Specialises [`Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md) with sensor-specific properties (sensory property, sensor platform, sampling feature).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SensoryObservation`](gmeow-SensoryObservation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
